Third-party source notices

Wine 11.20, official source commit 7298a818b79446bae153b8d5aa27235ab3703bf9.
The Wine patch contexts and modifications are LGPL-2.1-or-later. See wine/COPYING.LIB
and original source-file copyright notices. The source archive retains the full
upstream notices. Locally modified files and dates are identified by the patch
series and runtime-lock.json. Do not present local patches as upstream releases.

X.Org libX11 1.8.14. See xlib/COPYING for the complete set of historical copyright
and permission notices. The locking patch retains those terms.

Valve gamescope 3.16.25, source commit 17baf4abd1ab3353fb705e4d0d023f84e870f7e8.
See gamescope/LICENSE: BSD-2-Clause core plus BSD-3-Clause notices for included
OpenColorIO and ReShade portions. Preserve all applicable notices when distributing
source or binaries. One patch is an official Valve commit; the Vulkan shutdown
patch is a local modification.

The source builder downloads pinned upstream gamescope subprojects for compilation
(wlroots, libliftoff, vkroots, ReShade, SPIRV-Headers, GLM and stb). They are not
vendored in this source package. Their original source/license notices remain in
the extracted build trees; consult those licenses before redistributing binaries.
Host build and runtime dependencies retain their individual licenses.

The optional native assertion tracer, source builder and their regression tests
are original project code under the root MIT license. Quantower and other vendor
software/artwork are not included or licensed by this project. Users obtain the
application separately from its publisher under the applicable terms.
